primary_method: Screened Empirical Accumulation with Weather GBR

high_frequency.future_forecast_granularity: Hourly / daily Open-Meteo aggregated forecast (no sub-minute cloud prediction)

no_optical_soiling_sensor.description: PVDAQ System 10 has no optical soiling station. Soiling figures are model-estimated performance deviations, not confirmed dust accumulation.

no_direct_snow_depth_measurement.description: Weather data records precipitation_sum and temperatures but no snowfall depth. Flagged events are inferred proxies (freezing precip / zero-gen proxy) and may also reflect inverter trips or data dropouts.

sub_daily_forecast_cloud_dynamics.description: Historical 1-minute POA data provides within-day variability analysis for historical records. Future forecasts use Open-Meteo hourly/daily feeds; sub-minute cloud prediction or ramp-rate forecasting is not supported.

daily.snow_indicator_method: Inferred from freezing temperatures and daytime zero-generation proxy; direct snowfall depth was not measured
daily.limitation_note: Weather-aware screening reduces the influence of selected confounding conditions but cannot completely distinguish soiling from clouds, snow, shading, equipment faults, or model error. Direct soiling measurements are not available.

data_limitations.no_dedicated_optical_soiling_sensor: PVDAQ System 10 does not have a reference optical soiling station or cleaned control panels. All soiling metrics are model-estimated performance deviations from a baseline, not confirmed dust accumulation.
data_limitations.lack_of_direct_snow_depth_measurement: The weather dataset contains liquid precipitation and temperature but no direct snowfall depth or snow sensor. Snow events are inferred proxies based on freezing temperatures and daytime zero-generation signatures. Zero generation can also result from equipment faults, inverter trips, or data dropouts; snow is not claimed as conclusively detected.
data_limitations.sub_daily_cloud_dynamics_in_forecasts: Historical 1-minute POA irradiance measurements allow within-day cloud variability analysis on recorded data. However, future weather forecasts from Open-Meteo provide daily/hourly resolution only; sub-minute cloud prediction, cloud-edge forecasting, or inverter ramp-rate forecasting is not claimed or supported.

scientific_validation_notes: 1. No Dedicated Optical Soiling Sensor: Figures are model-estimated performance deviations, not confirmed dust.
2. Lack of Direct Snow Depth: Winter flags are inferred proxies (freezing precip / zero-gen proxy), not confirmed snow coverage.
3. Sub-Daily Cloud Dynamics: Historical 1-min POA is strictly separated from Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast resolution.
Screening reduced held-out test MAE from 2.429% to 2.284%.

Weather-aware screening reduces the influence of selected confounding conditions but cannot completely distinguish soiling from clouds, snow, shading, equipment faults, or model error. Direct soiling measurements are not available.
